notes: Jank settles at 7: proven mana and broad protection establish the floor, while Padeem, Spellskite, Crystal Shard, Keep Safe, and Pili-Pala plus Grand Architect make protection and combo lines unusually artifact-centric. Fun remains high because sequencing protection, deciding when to expose the King, and choosing destroy targets create real decisions. Oppressiveness remains 7 because repeated unconditional permanent destruction, including lands, is still the primary action. Thirteen printed Scarecrows in the 99 plus ten changeling creatures keep the tribe central, but the identity score remains 8 because playability occupies more slots than the original list.
